verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents Slack and PagerDuty integrations for error alerts and webhooks for custom routing, plus project/dashboard filtering and 'new issue' style status views. However, there is no evidence of configurable per-rule thresholds for frequency spikes or affected-user counts, nor explicit severity- or environment-based routing rules, or email alert configuration specifics. missing for 10: documented threshold-based alert rules (frequency spike, affected-user count), environment/severity-based routing configuration, email alerting evidence.
